reply.answer_text: Yes, the 5% allowance is cumulative. You can carry forward unused allowances from earlier years up to a maximum of 100% of the amount invested. It's a tax deferral, not an exemption — withdrawals within the allowance are not immediately taxed, but they count towards the final gain on the bond.
